entries.wording: Empty Container Released To Shipper From Pier/Terminal/Off-Dock Depot
entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with Wan Hai.

entries.wording: Outbound Full Container Gate In To Peir/Terminal(Fcl)
entries.note: The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading. After the container moved, a further gate in is transit.

entries.wording: Inbound/Outbound Laden Ctnr Move From One Pier/Terminal To Another One By Trucker/Rail.
Full Or Empty Container Loaded On Board Feeder'S Vessel Or Other Liner'S Vessel With No Fixed Slot
entries.note: A booking's own container, loaded on a feeder.

entries.wording: Laden Ctnr Loaded On Board Vessel.(Mother Vessel,Fixed Slot Charter/Joint Venture Vessel)
Laden Or Empty Transit Container Discharged From Own Or Feeder Vessel At Pier/Terminal Awaiting For
entries.note: Discharged at a transshipment port for its next vessel.

entries.wording: Full Container(Fcl) Discharged From Vessel Or Gate In To Pier/Terminal
Full Container Withdrawn By Consignee From Pier/Terminal
entries.note: The consignee takes the loaded container from the port.

entries.wording: Empty Container Discharged From Vessel Or Gate In To Pier/Terminal/Off-Dock Depot (Empty Available)
entries.note: The consignee returns the unloaded container. Before the container moved, it is an empty container returned unused.
